title: Reuse the retained-product absorption law and price trapped residence time
statement: Active A has rates a to correct C, d_A to irreversible damage, and j*b to trapped T. T returns to the same competent A at r_esc or fails at x+d_T. For a>0 and r_esc+x+d_T>0, P_A=a/[a+d_A+j*b*(x+d_T)/(r_esc+x+d_T)]. With d_A=x=d_T=0 and r_esc>0, P_A=1 and E[T_L]=L/a+b*L*(L-1)/(2*a*r_esc) for stages j0..L-1.

requires: a>0, nonnegative constant rates, integer j>=0, r_esc+x+d_T>0, and trapping returns the same competent active state.
Lossless eventual success and finite mean additionally require d_A=x=d_T=0 and r_esc>0, with the same rate law across correctly reached stages.

assumptions: Reversible capture is not automatically wrong joining; time and absorption targets differ.
Zero escape, aging, correlated/nonexponential residence and processing damage change the legal model.
costs: Pay active/escape residence time and its L-dependent accumulation, actual donor clearance, damage/aging and all optional protection/restoration processing.
contract.units: a,b_k,b,r_esc,d_A,x,d_T are inverse-time rates. L,j,k count additions or retained sites; alpha and S_L dimensionless. Distance index k and escape rate r_esc are distinct. F_L/P_j are conditional model probabilities, not measured yield, starting-root recovery or throughput.
contract.obstruction: Measure actual competence/escape and irreversible channels before importing this lossless result into a chemical controller.

body: Earlier U1025-retained-product-diversion already supplies the correct-versus-permanent-failure probability under k=a,w=d_A,x_old=x+d_T,h=lambda=0,r=r_esc. This mapping coarsens failure labels only, not physical chemical state or all dynamics. The current source adds explicit residence-time accounting and fatal trapped-state/active-state distinctions. First-step equations are(a+d_A+j*b)*P_A-j*b*P_T=a and-r_esc*P_A+(r_esc+x+d_T)*P_T=0. Eliminate P_T to obtain the exact success probability. This probability-only effective hazard does not reproduce the complete waiting-time distribution. In the lossless branch, renewal gives t_A=(1+j*b/r_esc)/a, then summing stages yields the displayed mean. Curator diagnostic with a2,b3,r_esc1,j1 and no failure has eventual success1 versus2/5 if all capture were falsely counted as irreversible. At r_esc=x=d_T=d_A=0, accessible T is absorbing instead: eventual success is a/(a+j*b), and the claimed lossless mean does not apply. Same-parent competence, memoryless rates and absence of aging are real hypotheses. The older mask model has a separate irreversible U->D channel and an equilibrium initial state; reversibility of masking does not remove that killing flux.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed intake-author audit of native lines35–97. Reconstructed the per-stage exponential race product, finite double-sum exposure, power-law exposure bounds, log-versus-exposure distinction and fixed-rate long-chain upper bound. Reconstructed the two-state first-step absorption equations and the lossless renewal mean, with explicit positive escape/nondegeneracy requirements. Exact Fraction checks exercise finite products/harmonic sums, two-state linear systems, lossless means, zero-escape failure and reversible-capture versus irreversible-error counterexamples. Small algebraic diagnostics are curator checks, not producer Monte Carlo/ODE replay or measured chemistry. Deduplication recovers the absorption probability from earlier U1025-retained-product-diversion under k=a,w=d_A,x_old=x+d_T,h=lambda=0,r=r_esc, preserving correct-versus-failure probability only. Its old lossless detour count also gives the residence-time refinement after paying mean1/r_esc per trap plus active L/a. This is explicit reuse, not an independent new absorption theorem; wrong-versus-dead labels and complete dynamics are not preserved by that coarsening. Both older source passages were read to preserve their valid scopes. Current producer derivation/twoPython originals, numerical results and source-paper originals were not acquired. No original producer programme, scientific simulation suite, primary-paper audit or physical experiment executed; proposed chemistry/parameter screens and practical/priority claims remain unacquired.
